description: Starts a durable layout job for a saved board at expectedRevision and returns without waiting for completion. Use after creating or editing a schematic; poll its exact generation ID with get_generation. Successful completion replaces the saved layout. A unique requestId supports identical retries. revision_conflict requires a fresh get_board; board_busy identifies an already active job to poll. Subject to normal compute capacity and board complexity limits, without AI credits. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

boardId.description: Saved board ID from list_boards, create_board, claim_guest_board, or an account board URL. Must be accessible to the current account or guest session.

expectedRevision.description: Saved revision returned by get_board. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before preparing a new operation.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

requestId.description: New UUID for this operation. Reuse it with identical arguments when retrying an uncertain result; use a new UUID for a different operation.

name: generate_layout
title: Generate PCB layout
